description: HTML source file for a database visualizer web interface, including embedded CSS and JavaScript to handle database selection, table viewing, and dynamic data rendering.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list in the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and lengthy strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for wide or object data.
